_comment: Trading rules file for the TradingView MCP, retargeted to Nasdaq micro futures. Place at ~/tradingview-mcp/rules.json. Edit freely — this is YOUR rule set, not advice.

strategy.name: EMA 9/21 crossover (from The Backtest Machine)
strategy.entry: 9 EMA closes above 21 EMA -> long, long-only
strategy.note: EMA 9/21 was the winner on Bitcoin, not the Nasdaq. On MNQ it has historically underperformed buy-and-hold. Re-test on your window before trusting it.

bias_criteria.bullish: Price above 50D EMA, 9 EMA above 21 EMA on the daily, higher highs and higher lows on 4H
bias_criteria.bearish: Price below 50D EMA, 9 EMA below 21 EMA on the daily, lower highs and lower lows on 4H
bias_criteria.neutral: Price chopping around the 50D EMA, EMAs entangled, no clear structure
